notes: Kett "Hive Battery" (full layers only with 3 operators): an amber chitin frame holding a flower of seven big hive cells, each a blue shield cell. On loop (8): a wave of light runs round the six outer cells while the centre cell breathes; arcs crawl between the corner plates. hit (3): flare and ripple. recharge (4): the cells spinning up from dim. Damaged: one outer cell cracked and dark, the frame split at the corner with a flap hanging, the wave stutters. Disabled: every cell dark and grey, the frame split, the centre cell burst. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
